meta.name: caveman-review
meta.description: Compressed code review - one line per finding with location, problem and fix. Use for /caveman-review, "review this PR", or "review the diff".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把代码审查压缩成逐条问题清单
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常要快速review合并请求。
copy.tagline_en: Review code changes with one-line findings per issue.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently review pull requests and want compressed feedback.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 的代码评审意见会变成压缩格式:每条发现一行,列出位置(行号或文件名:行号)、问题、修复建议,不加客套话。遇到安全漏洞、架构分歧或新手需要讲解时,会临时改回完整段落说明。
howto.when: 当用户说“/caveman-review”、“review this PR”或“review the diff”时触发;之后保持精简风格,直到用户要求停止或恢复正常模式。

say.text: 用 /caveman-review 审一下这个 PR
say.note: 每条问题一行,含行号、问题与修复建议。

say.text: review this PR,只看 diff 里的真实问题
say.note: 输出可直接粘贴到 PR 的精简评审意见。
会省略铺垫,只留问题与修复。

howto.what_en: Claude's code reviews become compressed: one finding per line with location, problem, and fix; no filler. Security defects, architecture disputes, or onboarding cases get a full paragraph before returning to terse style.
howto.when_en: Triggered by "/caveman-review", "review this PR", or "review the diff". It stays terse until the user asks to stop or return to normal mode.

say_en.note: Each finding is one line: location, problem, fix.

say_en.text: Review this PR and point out real issues in the diff.
say_en.note: Output is terse and paste-ready; no filler.

say_en.text: Review the diff and skip the pleasantries.
say_en.note: No hedging or praise; just findings and fixes.
